name: Central Asian portable felt dwelling
description: The ger or yurt combines a wooden trellis with felt covering in a dwelling that can be moved, dismantled and reassembled.

impact.note: Stands for the dwelling of steppe herders across one region, which made mobile pastoral life workable there; little later discovery is known to rest on it.
